tools.name: cn_workday_check
tools.description: Is a date a working day in mainland China? Applies State Council (国务院) holiday notices: public holidays, weekend makeup workdays (调休补班) and ordinary weekends; returns the holiday name and the gov.cn source link. Pass date for one day, or from and to (inclusive, up to 366 days) to count and list work
